classDescriptions.athlete: Focus on building physical capacity, endurance, strength and bodily performance.
classDescriptions.strategist: Focus on planning, decision-making and building long-term goals.
classDescriptions.specialist: Focus on deeply mastering a specific area of knowledge or skill.
classDescriptions.entrepreneur: Focus on creating opportunities, taking calculated risks and turning ideas into results.
classDescriptions.leader: Focus on developing leadership, responsibility and coordinating people.
classDescriptions.researcher: Focus on continuous learning, investigation and deep understanding of complex subjects.
classDescriptions.creator: Focus on producing new things, developing ideas and turning concepts into concrete projects.
classDescriptions.communicator: Focus on communication, expression, networking and the ability to convey ideas.
classDescriptions.mentor: Focus on developing knowledge and the ability to teach, guide and develop others.
classDescriptions.executor: Focus on discipline, productivity and turning plans into consistent action.
classDescriptions.generalist: Focus on developing diverse skills and building a broad foundation.
classDescriptions.technical_specialist: Focus on developing technical mastery and solving complex problems.
classDescriptions.manager: Focus on organization and managing resources, projects, time and responsibilities.
classDescriptions.researcher_creator: Focus on turning acquired knowledge into new solutions and projects.
classDescriptions.leader_strategist: Focus on developing leadership combined with planning and decision-making.

classGuide.title: Classes

tutorial.title: System Guide
tutorial.intro: Welcome, Hunter. Follow the System to begin your ascension.

character.title: Awaken your Hunter
character.description: Create your Hunter and customize the avatar. Your class sets your current focus: Healer is Health, Mage is Study, and so on — pick the area you want to level up right now.

quests.title: Forge Quests
quests.description: Turn your tasks into Quests. Set the rank, deadline, recurrence and objectives for each one.

ranks.title: Ranks and Difficulty
ranks.description: Every Quest has a difficulty rank: E (very easy), D (easy), C (medium), B (hard), A (very hard) and S (extreme). The higher the rank, the more XP you earn on completion.

complete.title: Complete and level up
complete.description: Start and complete your Quests to earn XP, level up and climb ranks.

attributes.title: Distribute Attributes
attributes.description: Each level grants points to boost Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Vitality and Luck.

track.title: Track your ascension
track.description: Check your status and streak on the Dashboard, and relive every milestone in History.
